notes: τοῦ πλουσίου → 'the rich man's': the determiner and the supplied nominal go to the inner article, headed on the nominal, and the outer τῆς is emptied by the prenominal possessive (rules 57, 102). Leaving 'rich man's' whole on the adjective is the competing reading.
The preposition of the selected reading r01 is rendered 'with' (SBLGNT.LUK.16.21.v018).
